items.description: During my internship I developed a robust API for LLM metering and billing, integrated with Stripe webhooks.

items.organization: Google Developer Group on Campus, Polytechnic Institute of Beja
items.description: I coordinated student teams and organised tech events on key Google technologies such as Android development, AI/LLM tools and Google Cloud.
I bridged academia and industry, supporting projects and initiatives for young talent, including job and internship opportunities at companies such as NTT Data and NOS.

items.organization: Computer Engineering Student Association of the Polytechnic Institute of Beja (NEIIPBeja)
items.description: I lead initiatives that promote innovation, collaboration and professional development among technology students. I created teaching material and short courses for more than 50 participants: Git and GitHub Fundamentals, and Machine Learning Fundamentals. I also managed the association's LinkedIn and Instagram pages, publishing the events and projects NEIIPBeja organised.

I built an internal dashboard to support project-management processes, improving team visibility and operational efficiency. It used Laravel for the backend with a responsive JavaScript and SASS frontend. I was also trained in modern web technologies, including React and Next.js, gaining hands-on experience with component-based architecture and server-side rendering.
